anomaly.notes: Temperature rose immediately from first pump rotation — no thermal warmup period. This onset pattern is inconsistent with fouling or wear, which require extended operation to manifest. Consistent with inadequate lube oil flow from the first revolution.

Transmitter in maintenance bypass throughout startup. Lube oil flow alarm inhibited. Inadequate lube oil flow not alarmed despite being the root mechanism. This is a separate finding: incomplete post-maintenance restoration (Category H).
No pre-event trending anomaly. Bearing temperature was normal and stable before pump start, consistent with the post-maintenance baseline (pump not running).
